name: Pixel Post
summary: A pixel art love letter in two parts: shoot an arrow at the seal, then read the letter
about: A tiny 8-bit love letter that plays like a mini game. In part one a little cupid holds a bow on a starry hill: hold to pull while the power bar swings, let go in the pink zone and the arrow arcs into the heart seal, which bursts into hearts as the envelope opens. In part two the screen dissolves into a pink page where your letter types itself in a hand-made pixel font. Write your own words and send it as a link.
how: Hold the Hold to pull button (or the screen, Space or Enter) and watch the power bar swing.
Let go inside the pink zone: the arrow flies in an arc; too soft lands in the grass, too strong flies past, and after four misses cupid helps you aim.
On a hit the seal bursts into hearts, the flap opens, the letter rises and the screen dissolves into part two.
The letter types itself; tap the screen to finish it at once, then Read again or Shoot again.
Write your own letter, names and hearts with *, then copy the link; with reduced motion the shot lands at once and the letter shows in full.
